heading: Registered capabilities
text:
## Registered capabilities [LCAP.1]

A **capability** is a boolean setting with a stable name. Every program has
a setting for every capability: its dialect's, with its `use` block's
overrides applied ([LDIA.1.3]). The registry is the enumeration
`proto/capabilities.proto#Capability`; the stable name of a member is its
enum name without the `CAPABILITY_` prefix, in lower case.

Capabilities are of two kinds, in one namespace:

- a **strategy** capability chooses how the engine executes a program, and
  restricts constructs to those that strategy can run: `realtime`,
  `constspace` and `linear_scan`;
- a **construct** capability permits a construct, and `false` forbids it:
  every other capability.

| Capability | Kind | A build may omit its code | Specified at |
|---|---|---|---|
| `realtime` | strategy | yes | [LCAP.2.1] |
| `constspace` | strategy | yes | [LCAP.2.6] |
| `linear_scan` | strategy | no | [LCAP.2.2] |
| `logical` | construct | no | [LCAP.2.3] |
| `dynamic_ttl` | construct | no | [LCAP.2.4] |
| `regex` | construct | yes | [LCAP.2.8] |
| `float` | construct | yes | [LCAP.2.9] |
| `call`, `publish`, `cache`, `cache_delete` | construct | no | [LFCA.2.1] |
| `series` | construct | no | [LFCA.5.1] |
| `nocooldown` | construct | no | [LFCA.6.1] |
| `sampled_slots`, `persist_on_series`, `storage_hydrate_facts`, `storage_hydrate_samples` | construct | yes | [LCAP.2.10] |

A runtime must contain the code for every capability marked "no". A
runtime may be built without the code for a capability marked "yes"; it
then refuses an artefact that requires that capability ([RDSC.16.2.7]).

`realtime` and `constspace` are deferred in this edition: the compiler
refuses a program that sets either `true` ([LCAP.2.1.5]). So are the four
storage and samples-plane capabilities ([LCAP.2.10]).

Which settings may be combined is constrained by [LCAP.3.8].
